dailyHeadline: CAAAAM SURVIVES 0.36-POINT THRILLER AT 11-0 WHILE TYLERO0 AND ELORD11 SWAP TEAMS AGAIN
dailySubhead: Week 11 left CarlaCote heartbroken at 144.70, JewsInParis spiraling on a 3-game skid, and the Rhody trade wire smoking ahead of today's Week 12 kickoffs.
tickerTape: HEARTBREAKER ON ROUTE 138: Caaaam (11-0) edges CarlaCote 145.06 to 144.70 by 0.36 points to keep perfection alive.
TRADE DESK ALERT: Tylero0 ships Jameson Williams & Tucker Kraft to trade-addict ELord11 for Trey McBride.
PANIC IN PARIS: After falling to 7-4 on a 3L streak, JewsInParis sends Travis Kelce & Stefon Diggs to Shipoopiehole for Kincaid, McConkey & Jordyn Tyson.
CEREALSTROKE MIRACLE: With $0 FAAB spent all year, CerealStroke drops 148.24 to crush ELord11 (129.66) for a 2W streak.
WAIVER WIRE SPLURGE: PrayingGrantis burns his final $19 FAAB on Chris Rodriguez Jr. while Tylero0 drops Mark Andrews for Tyler Higbee ($4).
WEEK 12 SPOTLIGHT: 11-0 Caaaam faces red-hot 2-9 CerealStroke while PrayingGrantis hosts CarlaCote in a heavyweight clash.

roasts.headline: ELord11's Intervention Delayed Again as Tylero0 & Shipoopiehole Exploit Desperation in Twin Blockbusters
roasts.body:
Somebody lock the Ryan Center doors and hide ELord11's phone before he trades away his own furniture. Sitting at 3-8 on a brutal six-game losing streak, ELord11 couldn't resist the itch on Tuesday afternoon, shipping away elite tight end Trey McBride to 8-3 powerhouse Tylero0 in exchange for Jameson Williams and Tucker Kraft. It is the third time this season ELord11 and Tylero0 have swapped assets—and judging by the standings, Tylero0 is basically using ELord11's roster as a Kingston farm system for his championship push.

Just five seconds earlier at 3:03 PM, JewsInParis finally snapped under the weight of a three-game losing streak and a devastating 126.36-122.34 Week 11 loss to Shipoopiehole. Looking to shake off the lingering curse of the Drake London-for-Jordan Mason disaster, JewsInParis sent Travis Kelce and Stefon Diggs to Shipoopiehole for Dalton Kincaid, Ladd McConkey, and Jordyn Tyson. Both managers walked away swearing they fixed their rosters, though Shipoopiehole immediately pivoted to grabbing Brandon Aiyuk off free agency to flex on his newfound receiver depth.

roasts.headline: 0.36 Points of Pure Pain: Caaaam Escapes CarlaCote's Witness Protection Ambush, Faces 2-9 CerealStroke Next
roasts.body:
Pour one out at Kingston Station for CarlaCote, who crawled out of witness protection in Week 11, dropped an absurd 144.70 points without spending a dime of her remaining $93 FAAB, and STILL lost to Caaaam 145.06-144.70. Winning by 0.36 points is the kind of horseshoe-level luck that keeps Caaaam's 11-0 undefeated juggernaut rolling—the same guy who blew 50 FAAB on a defense in Week 1 and now sits atop the league at 1,655.22 points for while writing smug victory newsletters.

Week 12 brings no rest for the wicked or the chaotic. Caaaam puts his 11-0 streak on the line against CerealStroke, who somehow just detonated for a league-high 148.24 points to bury ELord11 despite spending literally $0 FAAB all season. Meanwhile, CarlaCote (6-5) has zero time to mourn her 0.36-point tragedy because she immediately draws 8-3 superteam PrayingGrantis (1,652.02 PF), and Tylero0 gets a celebratory layup against his favorite trade partner, ELord11.

roasts.headline: PrayingGrantis Empties the FAAB Clip on Chris Rodriguez Jr. While Tylero0 Sends Mark Andrews to the Glue Factory
roasts.body:
At 3:06 AM Wednesday morning, while normal URI students were asleep in Butterfield, PrayingGrantis slammed his final $19 FAAB onto the table to claim Chris Rodriguez Jr. and drop Xavier Hutchinson. That officially brings PrayingGrantis to 100 FAAB spent, joining Caaaam and Unanswered in the zero-budget club—though with 1,652.02 points for and 242.52 bench points left behind, his biggest opponent remains his own start-sit button.

Elsewhere on the wire, Tylero0 made the coldest cut of the morning, dropping Mark Andrews for $4 Tyler Higbee and paying $6 for Konata Mumpfield before scooping Corey Kiner for free at noon. Not to be outdone in the panic department, JewsInParis dropped Sam Darnold, Wan'Dale Robinson, Elic Ayomanor, and the Bills defense just to bring in Makai Lemon ($6) and Kenny Gainwell ($2), while 2-9 owenriddell bravely swapped the Lions defense for the Commanders defense like rearranging deck chairs on the Titanic.

roasts.headline: The 11-0 King, the 8-3 Heavyweights, and the 3-8 Basement Brawl for Respectability
roasts.body:
With Week 12 kicking off today, the Rhody playoff picture has split sharper than a Narragansett Pier rip current. Caaaam (11-0) has a three-game stranglehold on the one-seed, while PrayingGrantis (8-3, 1,652.02 PF) and Tylero0 (8-3, 1,623.32 PF) are locked in a dead heat for the second bye. Right behind them, JewsInParis (7-4, 3L) and CarlaCote (6-5, 1L) are desperately trying to fend off 5-6 Unanswered, who needs a Week 12 upset over JewsInParis to keep his postseason pulse alive.

Down in the dungeon, things are bleak and loud. ELord11 (3-8, 6L) actually has 1,418.96 points for—more than Unanswered and Shipoopiehole—yet finds new ways to lose every Sunday while CerealStroke (2-9, 2W) suddenly remembered how fantasy football works by leaving 227.84 bench points behind and still torching people. At least Shipoopiehole (3-8, 2W) has a league-worst 1,630.94 points against to blame for his misery; owenriddell (2-9, 8L) just scored 81.78 points and has $77 FAAB rotting in his pocket.

powerRankings.blurb: At 11-0 with a league-leading 1,655.22 PF and the league's lowest 1,370.26 PA, the Week 1 50-FAAB defense spender somehow escaped CarlaCote by 0.36 points (145.06-144.70). He has $0 FAAB left, 224.1 bench points wasted, and an upcoming date with 2-9 CerealStroke that feels like a trap written in neon.

Sitting at 8-3 on a 3W streak with 1,652.02 PF, this superteam just burned its last $19 FAAB on Chris Rodriguez Jr. after handing Nico Collins and Blake Corum to CarlaCote for Matthew Golden. His biggest threat isn't Caaaam—it's his league-worst 242.52 bench points left behind every week.

Tylero0 (8-3, 1,623.32 PF) crushed owenriddell 147.84-81.78 and immediately fleeced ELord11 out of Trey McBride for Jameson Williams and Tucker Kraft. He also cut Mark Andrews for Tyler Higbee ($4) and still has $13 FAAB left to bully the wire before facing ELord11 this week.

Only CarlaCote (6-5, 1,519.52 PF) could stay invisible with $93 FAAB untouched, fleece PrayingGrantis for Nico Collins, drop 144.70 points, and still lose by 0.36 to Caaaam. She draws PrayingGrantis in Week 12 for an immediate revenge opportunity.

A 7-4 record looks pretty until you notice the 3L streak, 1,541.10 PA, and Sunday's 126.36-122.34 loss to Shipoopiehole. Shipping Travis Kelce and Stefon Diggs for Kincaid, McConkey, and Tyson while rage-dropping Sam Darnold and Wan'Dale Robinson screams full-blown panic ahead of Week 12 vs. Unanswered.

Dropping to 5-6 on a 2L skid after a limp 108.50-119.30 loss to PrayingGrantis, Unanswered has 1,403.00 PF and $0 FAAB left in the tank. Cutting Bryce Young on Wednesday clears dead weight, but beating JewsInParis in Week 12 is mandatory to stay alive.

Don't look now, but 3-8 Shipoopiehole is riding a 2W streak after upsetting JewsInParis 126.36-122.34 despite absorbing a brutal 1,630.94 PA all year. Adding Travis Kelce, Stefon Diggs, Brandon Aiyuk, and Drew Stevens ($1) sets up a very winnable Week 12 tilt against owenriddell.

Sitting at 2-9 with a league-worst 1,205.04 PF and 227.84 bench points wasted, CerealStroke still refuses to touch his $100 FAAB—and yet just dropped 148.24 to win his second straight game. Knocking off 11-0 Caaaam in Week 12 would break the entire Rhody desk.

Six straight losses have buried ELord11 at 3-8 despite a respectable 1,418.96 PF, and losing 148.24-129.66 to CerealStroke clearly broke his brain. Trading Trey McBride to Tylero0 for Jameson Williams and Tucker Kraft right before playing Tylero0 in Week 12 is peak self-sabotage.

Eight straight losses, 2-9, 1,236.96 PF, and an embarrassing 81.78-point faceplant against Tylero0 in Week 11. Still hoarding $77 FAAB while swapping Detroit's defense for Washington's defense ahead of Shipoopiehole is pure white-flag energy.

tradeGrades.summary: Tylero0 received Trey McBride (TE - ARI); ELord11 received Jameson Williams (WR - DET), Tucker Kraft (TE - GB)
tradeGrades.verdict: At 3-8, ELord11 is feeding the rich again by handing an elite difference-maker at tight end to 8-3 Tylero0 for a boom-or-bust receiver and a TE downgrade. Tylero0 immediately turns around and faces ELord11 in Week 12 with his shiny new toy.

tradeGrades.summary: Shipoopiehole received Travis Kelce (TE - KC), Stefon Diggs (WR - WAS); JewsInParis received Dalton Kincaid (TE - BUF), Ladd McConkey (WR - LAC), Jordyn Tyson (WR - NO)
tradeGrades.verdict: JewsInParis got younger and deeper to snap a three-game skid, adding Ladd McConkey and Dalton Kincaid alongside rookie Jordyn Tyson. Still, Shipoopiehole walked away with the proven name-brand ceiling of Travis Kelce and Stefon Diggs right after already beating JewsInParis on the scoreboard.

tradeGrades.summary: CarlaCote received Nico Collins (WR - HOU), Blake Corum (RB - LAR); PrayingGrantis received Matthew Golden (WR - GB)
tradeGrades.verdict: CarlaCote rarely pokes her head out of witness protection, so when she does, you should check your wallet—she walked away with Nico Collins and Blake Corum for Matthew Golden. Only PrayingGrantis's absurd 1,652.02 PF cushion keeps this from tanking his season.

tradeGrades.summary: ELord11 received Drake London (WR - ATL), Garrett Wilson (WR - NYJ); Tylero0 received Puka Nacua (WR - LAR)
tradeGrades.verdict: ELord11 chased a 2-for-1 volume haul with Drake London and Garrett Wilson, yet his team immediately cratered into a 6-game losing streak. Meanwhile, Tylero0 consolidated into Puka Nacua and kept marching toward an 8-3 bye contention.
